course_name_en: Validation and Test of Agricultural Machines
prerequisites: Knowledge of electrical engineering and measurement technology.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can critically select, perform, and prepare results of measurement procedures for determining operating parameters on agricultural machines and tractors.
They can select suitable and available measuring devices considering data acquisition in a heterogeneous environment of, for example, soil and plant properties.

Students apply standardized measurement and evaluation procedures using commercially available hardware and software. They create concepts for measurement chains, subject them to systematic analysis, conduct practical investigations in teams, and evaluate results in dialogue with other students. Students can present the results to interested farmers, engineers, and employees in customer service and sales. Students use a variety of different measurement and evaluation devices, which represent both standard tasks and specialized solutions adapted to agricultural technology.
collect, evaluate, and interpret relevant information.
develop solutions and realize solutions in accordance with the state of the art.
formulate technical and factual problem solutions within their actions and can justify them in discussion with experts and non-experts with theoretically and methodologically sound arguments.
justify their own professional actions with theoretical and methodological knowledge.

syllabus_topics: Execution and evaluation of measurements on agricultural machines
Tractive force measurement on agricultural tractors
Determination of straw bale density depending on press setting parameters
Determination of spreading accuracy of fertilizer spreaders
Determination of the draft force requirement of tillage equipment
